positions.title: Full Stack Engineer III
positions.description:
• Leading technical discovery and design for customer-facing feature serving 94M+ active users, collaborating with cross-functional teams to define requirements and implementation strategy.

• Architected event-driven GCP data pipeline synchronizing merchant data across 1M+ accounts at 15k TPS.
positions.insights: Skills: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Terraform · Node.js · React.js · GraphQL

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and deployed a real-time education platform using Kotlin, Next.js, WebRTC, and a custom SFU. enabling scalable group audio calls, collaborative white-boarding and code sharing leading to 300% user growth post-launch.
• Built a fully typed multi-language gRPC SDK spanning 200+ APIs for Python, Kotlin, and TypeScript, streamlining cross-language integration with auto-generated types and dual ESM/CJS builds.
• Implemented a self-hosted STT, TTS, and Realtime RAG pipeline in PyTorch to power multi-language transcription for real-time AI-driven Interview feedback and analysis.
• Engineered a PostgreSQL CDC using Debezium and Spring Boot to broadcast real-time session data via WebSockets, eliminating polling and enabling instant UI updates.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded a cloud optimization strategy with Terraform, Ansible, ECS, and Kubernetes, slashing operational costs by 60% ($18K/month savings).

• Rearchitected a $5M ARR platform, migrating Angular to Next.js and .NET 4 to .NET 8, introducing Docker and ECS, improving performance by
200% and cutting deployment times from weeks to minutes.

• Built an AI query layer on top of customer-facing APIs, enabling users to ask business questions in natural language and receive real-time answers from live MSSQL data.

•Led a full redesign and performance overhaul of the React Native mobile app, delivering a modernized UX and dramatically faster, smoother
experience for end users.

• Mentored 3 junior engineers on React, TypeScript, Docker, ROS, and SOLID principles, enhancing team output by 15%.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Large Language Models (LLM) · Kubernetes · Grafana · PyTorch

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Built a cross-platform music collaboration app in React Native, onboarded 1K beta testers, and shipped key features like Reels, location-based, discovery (geohashing), messaging, and follower system.
• Reduced video streaming costs by 60% for 10K+ monthly streams by optimizing AWS S3 storage and transcoding with FFmpeg.
• Designed and implemented a geohashing algorithm that enabled 500+ local musician matches, enhancing discovery and engagement.
• Launched a no-code CMS for journalist publishing, driving a 3x increase in SEO traffic and cutting reliance on dev team for content updates.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · TypeScript · React Native
